scope: All 20 released paper task IDs; 19 task bodies assessed for connected workflow patterns and one restricted objective retained as an identifier only. Biological inputs, answer artifacts and process-judge rubrics are not training seeds.
source_runtime: Runner README reports an average near eight hours and a 24-hour ceiling on substantially larger CPUs; no timings measured here.
grading_scope: Deterministic artifact grading and a separate model-based process judgment. This inventory adapts only independently verifiable operations.
